newsitem.title: USA: Executone buys stake in Internet Gaming.
newsitem.headline: Executone buys stake in Internet Gaming.

text.p: Internet Gaming Technologies Inc and Executone Information Systems Inc's Unistar Entertainment Inc said Monday they reached a definitive agreement under which Executone/Unistar would make an investment of $3 million into Internet Gaming at $5 a share.

Under the terms of the Agreement, the company said Executone/Unistar has made an initial purchase of 140,000 shares of Internet Gaming for a first round payment of $700,000. Internet Gaming said it said it anticipates completion of the purchase within the next several months.
